concept.hr: OU nosi pravila i delegiranje, grupa dozvole; jedan OU, mnogo grupa
concept.en: OUs carry policy and delegation, groups permissions; one OU, many groups

summary.hr: Razvrstaj osam zadataka u OU, grupu, oboje ili ništa: GPO se povezuje s OU-om, ACE navodi SID grupe, a delegiranje je na OU-u za grupu.
summary.en: Sort eight tasks into OU, group, both or neither: a GPO links to an OU, an ACE names a group's SID, and delegation sits on an OU for a group.
